## What's Changed
### Enhancements 🚀
* Make the Trivy API token optional by @arjavdongaonkar in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7178
* Tweak apiserver Dockerfile by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7180
* Make Dockerfile more layer cache friendly by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7181
* Allow operators to load external JDBC drivers by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7182
* Support inverted tag matching in policy scope by @arjavdongaonkar in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7176
* Refactor component metrics computation to avoid pathological query plans by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7214
* Add `analyzer_identity` in `NEW_VULNERABILITY` notifications by @sahibamittal in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7206
* Fix N+1 queries in dependency graph endpoint by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7275
* Improve efficiency of is_dependency_of and is_exclusive_dependency_of CEL functions by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7276
* Avoid redundant component iteration during dependency graph export by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7277
* Add checksum matching support for Snyk vuln analyzer by @mehab in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/6835
* Migrate cargo package metadata resolver to sparse index by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7315
* Implement service accounts by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7293
* Implement service account API key expiry by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7317
* Sign webhook payloads with HMAC-SHA256 by @adilalperenciftci in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7323
* Implement workload identity federation by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7330
* Make the monitoring dashboards usable outside the dev stack by @nissessenap in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7335
* Introduce outbound connection policy by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7449
* Integrate outbound connection policy with shared HTTP client by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7450
* Expose outbound connection policy to plugins by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7451
* Streamline JDBI mappers by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7466
* Support bracketed list strings in OIDC teams claim by @Akhil-1527 in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7467
* Bump spdx license list 3.29.0 by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7502
* Enforce a max size for BOM and VEX uploads by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7545
* Batch finding bulk operations and notification emission by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7608
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Run spotless:apply after Maven release plugin modifies them POM by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7138
* v4-migrator: Reconcile PROJECT collection logic and tag by @arjavdongaonkar in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7172
* v4-migrator: Dedup PROJECT_PROPERTY rows of collapsed projects by @arjavdongaonkar in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7171
* Fix PURLs without version being submitted for analysis by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7196
* Add option to use Snyk's per-package endpoint when batching is not available by @arjavdongaonkar in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7195
* Remove unused LDAP properties by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7240
* Fix management server preventing shutdown on initialization failures by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7278
* Fix incorrect OpenAPI docs for POST /v1/project WRT parent semantics by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7312
* Fix DATASOURCE_MIRRORING notifications not being emitted by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7313
* Fix project lookup endpoints not serving aggregate metrics for collection projects by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7311
* Resolve project parent before other fields in updateProject by @adityaanikam in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7262
* Treat >=0 ranges as wildcard during vers matching by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7329
* Fix broken link to VulnCheck token creation by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7347
* Accumulate mirrored VulnerableSoftware by vulnerability key by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7351
* Fix Checkmarx model conversion NPEs by @sahibamittal in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7352
* Fix tag binding triggering unnecessary relationship loads by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7353
* Fix OS package scanning for Trivy analyzer by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7355
* Prevent NPEs during DataNucleus L1 cache eviction by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7357
* Fix proxy authentication for GitHub Advisories vuln data source by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7356
* Fix calculated CVSSv4 score only considering base metrics by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7358
* Fix NVD vuln data source iteration and watermarking issues by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7359
* Move vuln data source mirroring off JDO by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7382
* Fix lack of context in NVD & OSV unexpected status code exception messages by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7385
* Fix invalid PURLs causing list API endpoints to fail by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7501
* Fix failure to match CPE with wildcard version and version range >=0 by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7514
* Fix internal vulns with finding attributions failing deletion by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7542
* PEP 503-normalize PyPI package names for vuln matching by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7546
* Treat NuGet package names as case-insensitive for vuln matching by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7547
* Fix manually assigned findings being deactivated on analysis by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7551
* Fix Trivy findings dropped for PURLs with URL-valued qualifiers by @nissessenap in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7581
* Consistently tolerate trailing slashes in configurable URLs by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7607
* Fix collection project metrics shape when children have no metrics by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7609
* Fix missing pagination in `/v1/vulnerability/component/{uuid}` by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7610

> [!WARNING]
> This release drops the compatibility shim that translated v4-era `alpine.*` and unprefixed property names (for example `alpine.ldap.enabled`, `database.url`, `bcrypt.rounds`) into their `dt.*` equivalents. Migrate any configuration still using those names to the current `dt.*` properties. **The API server refuses to start when it encounters a legacy key** to prevent silent misconfiguration.
> 
> The original `alpine.*` to `dt.*` migration is documented in the [v0.7.0-alpha.3 upgrade notes](https://dependencytrack.github.io/docs/next/guides/upgrading/v0.7.0-alpha.3/). See [Configuration Properties](https://dependencytrack.github.io/docs/next/reference/configuration/properties/) for the authoritative list of supported properties and their corresponding environment variable spellings.
> 
> Apologies for introducing breaking changes in an RC build.

Find the full upgrade guide here: https://dependencytrack.github.io/docs/next/guides/upgrading/v5.0.0-rc.2/
